_comment: Copy this file to pipeline/settings.json and edit it. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Every key is documented in pipeline/README.md. Paths are relative to the repository root unless absolute.
_track: 'standard' (3,720-hour IAP) or 'syllabus' (9,800-hour RAIC Syllabus Program). Sets the dashboard targets and the category-balance tie-break in suggest_cerb_sections.py.
_jurisdiction: Your provincial/territorial regulator. Used for the reviewer persona and the dashboard subtitle.
_period: A CERB period ends at whichever comes first: period_months after the start date, or period_hours_cap eligible hours.
_backlog: Optional. null = off. When set to YYYY-MM-DD, periods ending BEFORE this date get backlog_text written into Mentor Identification (surname), the 4 Comments by Employer boxes and the Mentor Declaration name. Use only if your jurisdiction accepts retroactive backlog submissions this way.
_internal_bucket_names: Project Metadata names used for non-project time. They never receive a CERB Section suggestion and are reported separately when excluded.
_thin_project_hours: When a period has more projects than fit on one page, projects under this many hours are listed as candidates you may choose to leave out (run_period.py prepare --drop-project).
_role_of_intern_header: First line of the form's page-2 'Role of Intern' field; the per-project synopsis follows it.
role_of_intern_header: ** Refer to the attached Project Descriptions document for full project details and hours. Synopsis listed below:
_max_projects_per_page: Project columns per form sheet. The official form has 10; extra projects go on continuation sheets numbered 11, 12, 13...
_form_pdf: The official fillable CERB PDF. Not included in this repository - see form/README.md.
_exports_dir: Where each period's outputs go (exports/<end-date>/) plus the dashboard.
